title: A Comparison of Gauge Dimension and Effective Dimension
summary: We characterize the gauge profile of $\mathcal{D}_s$, the set of reals with effective dimension $s$, and $\mathcal{D}_{\leq s}$, the set of reals with effective dimension $\leq s$. Let $W(s)$ be the set of reals that are $s$-well approximable. This gives us a separation between $\mathcal{D}_{\leq s}$ and $W(2/s)$ in terms of Hausdorff measure.
